# FieldProvenance

Records how a specific field's value was obtained — manual entry, AI extraction, import, OCR, or computation

Source: [`v3/common/field-provenance.json`](../../../v3/common/field-provenance.json)

Schema `$id`: `https://openinherit.org/v3/common/field-provenance.json`

## Properties

| Property | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `field` | `string` | yes | The field name this provenance record applies to |
| `method` | one of `manual_entry`, `ai_extracted`, `imported`, `computed`, `ocr_scanned` or `string` | yes | How the field value was obtained |
| `confidence` | `integer` | | Confidence in the field value (0-100) |
| `verifiedAt` | `string` (date-time) | | When this field was last verified |
| `verifiedBy` | `string` | | Who verified this field |
| `sourceDocumentId` | `string` (uuid) | | Reference to the document.json entity this value was extracted from |
| `sourcePageNumber` | `integer` | | Page number in the source document where this value was found |
| `sourceRegion` | `string` | | Location within the page where this value was found |
| `originalText` | `string` | | The raw text as extracted before any normalisation or structuring. Preserves exactly what the source document said |
| `originalScript` | one of `latin`, `kanji`, `hiragana`, `katakana`, `arabic`, `hebrew`, `devanagari`, `tamil`, `chinese_simplified`, `chinese_traditional`, `hangul`, `cyrillic`, `thai`, `mixed`, `other` or `string` | | Writing system of the source document. Critical for handwritten wills in non-Latin scripts |
| `ocrEngine` | `string` | | OCR engine or extraction tool used to obtain this value |
| `extractedAt` | `string` (date-time) | yes | When this value was extracted from the source document |
| `dataSource` | `object` | | The third-party source that provided this field value. Enables attribution credits and the data source kill switch |
